title: Form Renderer Coverage Demo
description: Single-action blueprint that exercises every ControlTypes value (Layout, Label, TextLine, TextArea, Numeric, DateTime, File, Choice, Checkbox, Selection), all three layout modes (flat + x-sections + x-pages wizard), x-width hints, x-rule conditional visibility, x-introduction page intros, and the x-persona autofill extension from Feature 092.
author: Sorcha Team

template.title: Form Renderer Coverage Demo
template.description: A single form that uses at least one of every form control type and form layout extension the renderer supports. Used to eyeball-test the SorchaFormRenderer and as a smoke test for new control changes.

metadata.features: x-pages, x-sections, x-rule, x-introduction, x-width, x-persona, file-reference

actions.title: Submit Coverage Form
actions.description: Complete every category of field so the renderer exercises every control type.

dataSchemas.x-introduction: This form exists to exercise every control type supported by the SorchaFormRenderer. There is no business logic behind it — please fill it in however you like. The final page has a deliberate conditional field that only appears when you tick the box above it.

x-pages.title: Identity
x-pages.description: Text inputs, date/time pickers, and persona autofill

x-sections.title: Your Name
x-sections.description: Given + family name. When Feature 092 persona autofill is enabled and you have saved these attributes, these fields prefill with a cream tint and `self` provenance tick.

x-sections.title: Contact
x-sections.description: Single-line text for the email (persona-aware) plus a multi-line note.

x-sections.title: Key Dates
x-sections.description: Date-of-birth picks up persona; appointment picker is a free choice.

x-pages.title: Numbers & Choices
x-pages.description: Numeric field, radio choice, dropdown selection, read-only label.

x-sections.title: Preferences
x-sections.description: Radio group (Choice) for the rating, dropdown (Selection) for the severity.

x-sections.title: Guidance
x-sections.description: Read-only Label control demonstrating static form text.

x-pages.title: Attachments & Consent
x-pages.description: File upload, conditional-visibility textarea, submission checkbox.

x-sections.title: Supporting Evidence
x-sections.description: Optional file attachment (≤ 40 MB, any type).

x-sections.title: Follow-Up
x-sections.description: Tick the box to reveal the follow-up note field (exercises x-rule SHOW).

email.title: Email Address
email.description: Persona autofill will populate this with your default email.

biography.title: Short Biography
biography.description: A few sentences about yourself. Any length over 500 characters is forced into the TextArea renderer by the auto-generator — we override that explicitly below too so the renderer always gets the TextArea control for this field.

appointmentAt.title: Appointment Timestamp
appointmentAt.description: Date-and-time picker demonstrating the date-time format.

satisfactionRating.title: How satisfied are you with this form?
satisfactionRating.description: Radio-button Choice control — pick exactly one.

helpNotice.title: Reminder
helpNotice.description: Rendered as a read-only Label. No input is collected for this field.
helpNotice.default: Your submission is encrypted end-to-end and only the reviewer can decrypt it.

wantsFollowUp.title: I would like a follow-up conversation about this submission
wantsFollowUp.description: Checkbox control. Ticking this reveals the follow-up notes field below.

followUpNotes.title: Follow-up notes
followUpNotes.description: Only visible when the box above is ticked — demonstrates x-rule SHOW.

confirmAccurate.title: I confirm the information on this form is accurate

routes.description: Forward the submission to the reviewer

actions.title: Acknowledge Submission
actions.description: Reviewer confirms receipt of the coverage form.

acknowledged.title: I have reviewed the submission
acknowledged.description: Tick to confirm you've seen the coverage form.

reviewerNote.title: Reviewer note
reviewerNote.description: Optional short note back to the submitter.
